name: smythos-studio
description: SmythOS Studio: Open-Source Visual AI Agent Builder and deployable runtime stack from SmythOS. Start with an intuitive drag-and-drop workspace, extend with custom code, and deploy your agents anywhere — local, cloud, or edge — with full governance and control.
readme_summary: SmythOS Studio is an open-source visual AI agent builder and runtime stack. It offers an intuitive drag-and-drop interface for creating AI agent workflows, with the flexibility to extend with custom code and deploy agents across various environments with full governance.
primary_use_case: Building, deploying, and managing intelligent AI agents through a visual, no-code to pro-code interface.
cover_image_prompt: A master architect standing in a vibrant, futuristic workshop, using a holographic blueprint to visually construct intelligent AI agents. The architect is dragging and dropping glowing components like 'LLM Integration' and 'Data Processor' onto the blueprint, which then materializes into a functional, friendly robot assistant. Small screens around the workshop display real-time agent performance metrics and code snippets. The overall scene is clean, bright, and conveys a sense of intuitive creation and powerful deployment. The style should be a 3D isometric illustration with a focus on clarity and a futuristic, yet accessible aesthetic, subtly featuring the 'SmythOS Studio' name on a blueprint element.

name: book-to-skill
description: Turn any technical book PDF into a Claude Code skill — ready to study, reference, and use while you work.
readme_summary: Book-to-skill is a Python tool that transforms technical books and documents into structured agent skills. It enables AI agents to efficiently reference and utilize the information from these sources, overcoming the limitations of traditional PDF searching or direct context dumping.
key_features: Converts technical books and documents into agent skills
Supports multiple input formats (PDF, EPUB, DOCX, MD, HTML, RTF, MOBI)
Enables on-demand loading of skills by AI agents
Reduces token usage compared to direct context inclusion
Integrates with AI agents like GitHub Copilot CLI, Amp, Claude Code, Hermes Agent, OpenCode, and OpenClaw
Structures content into frameworks, decision rules, anti-patterns, and per-chapter files
primary_use_case: To create structured, referenceable knowledge bases from technical books and documents that can be directly utilized by AI agents during work or study.
cover_image_prompt: A wise, friendly wizard, representing 'book-to-skill', stands in a library. He holds an open technical book, and from its pages, streams of organized, glowing data flow like a structured river into a digital interface representing an AI agent's knowledge base. Small, subtle icons of code snippets and charts float around the wizard, indicating the technical nature. The background shows neatly organized shelves of books, contrasting with the dynamic data flow. The overall mood is one of clarity and efficient knowledge transfer. The art style should be a vibrant 3D isometric illustration with a clean, modern aesthetic and soft, inviting lighting.

name: gridex
description: A native macOS / windows / Linux database IDE built with Swift and AppKit. Connect to PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, and Redis from a single app with a fast, keyboard-driven interface.
readme_summary: Gridex is a cross-platform database IDE for macOS, Windows, and Linux, supporting a wide range of databases including PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, Redis, MongoDB, SQL Server, and ClickHouse. It offers a unified interface for managing these databases, featuring a built-in MCP server and AI chat capabilities.
key_features: Support for multiple databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, Redis, MongoDB, SQL Server, ClickHouse)
Unified DatabaseAdapter protocol for consistent features across engines
primary_use_case: To provide a single, unified, and efficient application for developers and database administrators to connect to, query, and manage multiple types of databases across different operating systems.
cover_image_prompt: A skilled conductor standing at a podium, orchestrating a symphony of diverse musical instruments, each representing a different database (e.g., a regal trumpet for PostgreSQL, a rhythmic drum for MySQL, a delicate harp for SQLite, a pulsing synthesizer for Redis). The conductor's baton, glowing with digital energy, directs streams of data flowing from the instruments into a central, harmonious score displayed on a large, ethereal screen. Subtle UI elements of the Gridex application are visible on the screen, showing query results and database connections. The scene is set in a grand, modern concert hall with soft, focused lighting. The overall style is a 3D isometric illustration with clean lines and a vibrant, cohesive color palette, emphasizing unity and control.
